messages:
Marta Chen: Heads-up — GreenPort reseller applied a 20% partner discount to a committed reserved capacity invoice for Feb (INV-2026-0421) even though their contract only covers a 10% resell margin. Customer is asking for a corrected invoice. Can finance confirm next steps? @Alec Rivera @Finance Bot
Alec Rivera: thanks Marta — can you paste the invoice lines and the customer contract id? I want to verify the committed vs billable units before we touch credits.
Marta Chen: invoice extract below:
```
INV-2026-0421
- Reserved GPU hours (region-us-west) — 12,000 hrs @ $0.50 = $6,000.00
- Partner discount (applied) 20% = -$1,200.00
- Net billed = $4,800.00
```
Contract: GP-2025-COMM-10 (committed partner margin = 10%). Customer says they were charged the partner-discounted net instead of our committed billing.
Alec Rivera: ok math shows misapply. With 10% partner margin we should have applied -$600, net $5,400. Difference (credit) = $600. Any other line items?
Marta Chen: There was also a one-time onboarding credit the partner applied erroneously (-$50). So total credit owed = $650.
Finance Bot: Automated fraud/ops check: promo mismatch flag detected, ticket created (#FIN-3172). Recommended action: issue customer credit memo for $650 and adjust partner settlement. GL Suggestion: 4-2210 (Customer Credits).
Samir Kaur: tagging to request approval from Revenue Ops. @Iris Patel can you OK the customer credit and confirm whether we should make it a manual refund or a credit memo?
Iris Patel: Reviewed contract GP-2025-COMM-10 — approve credit memo for $650 to correct billing. Use credit memo (no cash out). :white_check_mark: Please adjust partner settlement so reseller margin reconciles on next payout.
Alec Rivera: noted. I'll create CM-2026-0783 and route to accounting. Marta — can you confirm the customer-facing note we should include?
Marta Chen: "We corrected a misapplied reseller discount on invoice INV-2026-0421. A $650 credit memo has been issued to offset the over-applied discount. No action is required on your end." Short and neutral.
Samir Kaur: executing create command now:
```
/create-credit --cust GreenPort --invoice INV-2026-0421 --amt 650 --type credit_memo --reason "reseller promo misapply"
```
System: CM-2026-0783 created and queued for posting. Accounting will post in EOD batch.
Alec Rivera: GL 4-2210 confirmed, partner settlement flagged for adjustment in payout queue. I added a note to FIN-3172.
Marta Chen: thanks all. Will notify the customer once the CM posts. Closing loop here after accounting posts. :thumbsup:
Finance Bot: FIN-3172 updated: credit_memo CM-2026-0783 issued, partner settlement action item assigned to payouts queue.
